summary: CVR Energy filed a preliminary 424B5 for a $750M common stock offering—$500M primary plus $250M by a selling stockholder—with a 30-day, $112.5M greenshoe from the seller. Last NYSE price was $55.92 on November 2, 2026. Net proceeds, with cash and other Financing Transactions, fund an unnamed Acquisition, redemption of the 2028 Notes, and fees. The offering is not contingent on the Acquisition, nor vice versa; shortfall proceeds would go to general corporate purposes. Barclays and Jefferies are joint book-running managers. This financing-related shelf takedown is tagged Acquisitions because proceeds fund a deal; watch pricing, deal announcement terms, and overhang.
